items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: He took the first one to Europe and I went over on the boat with him.

ctx.x: Very, very loud, oh yes. They were very, very loud. I bought one myself. And oh yes, I think there was a fellow named UnionJack, not Union Jack, but what is the aviator's name? The Black Eagle -- (who) MR. ALBERTSON: Oh, oh, I know you're talking about.
He took the first one to Europe and I went over on the boat with him.
